messages:
marta: Kickoff: split the in-process session-batcher into a standalone BatchPool service. Goal: simplify runtime, unify batching policy, and make batching observable.

nk: +1. The current in-process code has too many special cases. Externalizing should make backpressure and quotas consistent.

sam: Concern: tail latency for interactive requests. Need a low-latency fast-path.

ryan: Proposal: colocated fast-path (sidecar) + TTL cache in runtime for hot prefixes. IPC over unix socket, JSON for phase 1.

marta: API sketch: /enqueue (async token), /status (poll token), /hint (sync) for fast-path. Runtime uses hint when present.

nk: Migration plan (opt-in flags): 1) monitor (record only) 2) hinting opt-in per tenant 3) active for long-tail tenants w/ runtime fast-path for pinned tenants 4) deprecate in-process code. Add 24h shadowing step.

sam: Tests: microbench for small prompts, throughput tests, and ordering correctness tests. Also shadow mismatch alerts.

ryan: Circuit-breaker example to include in RFC: `batchpool.circuit.window_ms=30000, p99_threshold_ms=200, open_duration_ms=120000, fallback=local|bypass`. If open, runtime uses fallback.

marta: Ops: dashboards: enqueue_rate, batch_size_p95, batch_wait_p99, cache_hint_hit_rate, shadow_mismatch_count. Ownership: infra-batching owns BatchPool, infra-runtime owns runtime hooks, SRE owns SLOs, devex coordinates rollout. Add RACI to RFC.

devops-bot: New RFC draft created: session-batcher->batchpool by marta. Link: git/repo/rfcs/0000-batchpool.md (CI: pending).
